record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Let V be a simple C2-cofinite vertex operator algebra with V(0)=C1, V(n)=0 for n<0, V' equivalent to V, and every grading-restricted generalized V-module completely reducible, and let G be a finite group of automorphisms of V. Is the category of g-twisted V-modules for all g in G a G-crossed tensor category in Turaev's sense?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6.2. Let V be a vertex operator satisfying the three conditions in Conjecture 6.1 and let G be a finite group of automorphisms of V. The category of g-twisted V-modules for all g in G is a G-crossed (tensor) category in the sense of Turaev [T2].

artifact.category_tag: Vertex operator algebras and twisted modules
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture remains open in general. Recent works (2025) develop key ingredients toward a proof — including twisted intertwining operators, their tensor product theory, $C_n$-cofiniteness for twisted modules over $C_2$-cofinite VOAs, and cofiniteness of twisted fusion products — which are prerequisites for constructing the associativity and braiding isomorphisms of the conjectured $G$-crossed tensor structure. No general proof under the stated hypotheses has been published.

status_evidence.title: Twisted intertwining operators and tensor products of (generalized) twisted modules
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence of products of twisted intertwining operators plays an essential role in constructing the associator natural isomorphism in the G-crossed tensor category of twisted modules.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work develops the analytic and algebraic tools toward the G-crossed tensor category structure but does not yet establish the full conjecture.

status_evidence.title: C_n-cofinite twisted modules for C_2-cofinite vertex operator algebras
status_evidence.snippet: We introduce C_n-cofiniteness for weak g-twisted V-modules and prove cofiniteness results for C_2-cofinite V of CFT type.
status_evidence.claim: Cofiniteness results needed for the conjectured G-crossed tensor category structure are being established in 2025.

status_evidence.title: Cofiniteness for Twisted Fusion Products in Vertex Operator Algebra Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes cofiniteness of twisted fusion products, an ingredient in proving G-crossed tensor category structure.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing progress, but the full conjecture is not declared proved.
